newsitem.title: UK: West Ham soccer club raises funds, weighs float.
newsitem.headline: West Ham soccer club raises funds, weighs float.

text.p: London's West Ham United plc, parent of the Premier League football club of the same name, said on Friday it was close to raising 1.6 million stg through a private placement and was considering a possible float, depending of how it finishes the current soccer season.

In a statement the company said it had appointed Nomura International Plc as its financial adviser in conjunction with a review of its finances -- including its team, its stadium and its commercial operations.

"A decision on the timing of any flotation will depend on, amongst other things, stock market conditions and is unlikely to be taken before the end of the current season", the company said in a statement.

West Ham noted that the price at which it is expecting to place its new shares -- 3,200 of them at 500 stg each -- implied a value for the whole club of 50 million stg, "significantly higher than the value proposed by one recent potential private investor, Michael Tabor".
